| # LIN integration into an application {#lin-integration-into-an-application-1 .p_Heading1 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}                                                  |                                                                                                                 |
+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

The integration of the LIN communication stack has to be done with the following steps:

1)Prepare the BSW configuration within the easyConfig tool:

 Load the application specific LDF file in easyConfig. The following details will be read from the LDF file.

§The LIN communication baud rate information.

§Schedule tables information.

§Different frames along with the delay time\[ms\] information.

§Signals and there properties information.

    So based on the imported LDF file the BSW will be configured.

2)Include header file bds_lin.h within the application.

3)An example code is shown in the description of the function bds_lin_sendSignal() or bds_lin_receiveSignal().

 

  ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ![Notice_RGB 39-153-209](hmfile_hash_c5013a84.png){style="margin:0;width:1.4792in;height:0.2813in;border:none"}   Only Unconditional Frames are supported. Event-Triggered, Sporadic and Diagonostic frames are not yet supported.
